title: Set_Attributes_All with small service data
purpose: Exercise the interaction of a valid Message Router service code, a class-instance path, and a small service-data payload inside a correct SendRRData transport.
expected_behavior: The implementation should accept the valid encapsulation and CPF framing and then deliver a Set_Attributes_All request with two bytes of service data to higher-level handling.
constraints_preserved: Encapsulation length is 0x001a and matches 26 command-specific bytes.
SendRRData prefix includes interface handle and timeout.
CPF uses item_count 2, Null Address Item, and Unconnected Data Item.
Unconnected Data Item length is 10 and matches the CIP request size.
Service code 0x02 is the documented Set_Attributes_All service.
Path-size byte 0x02 matches the class-instance path.
issue_safety_notes: The small service-data block is mutation-friendly but remains structurally conservative.
